products.name: Decktopus
products.note: AI presentation maker; automated design; content generation; data exposure

profile_text.body:
Decktopus is a web-based AI presentation tool that describes itself as an AI presentation maker capable of generating complete slide decks from a single text prompt. According to its site, users provide a topic or upload an existing file, and the platform produces a finished deck with structure, content, and design included. The service is also available as an app inside ChatGPT, and it connects to external workflows through Zapier, allowing presentation generation to be triggered automatically from CRM updates or form submissions.

The company's core product, also called Decktopus, is categorized as a slides and presentations tool and is noted to include automated design, content generation, and data exposure considerations. The site states that data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256, hosted on AWS infrastructure, and that customer data is not used for AI training. SOC 2 Type II compliance is described as currently in progress. The platform does not offer a free plan but provides new users with free credits at signup to create a three-slide presentation.

The held facts confirm that Decktopus has a profile on theworldofai.org and one tracked product under the slides and presentations category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
